evidence.detail: Exact-v308 rs/s/b/g extends the plugin base and preserves descriptor strings name='Configuration' and tags='configs'.
Startup loads exact resource config_icon.png, resolves PluginListPanel and builds a NavigationButton with tooltip 'Configuration', priority 3 and that panel, then registers it through ClientToolbar.
The plugin injects ClientToolbar, Provider<PluginListPanel>, Provider of the adjacent top-level config UI helper, ConfigManager and stores the live navigation button/panel state.
RuneLite ConfigPlugin has the same Configuration descriptor, config_icon.png resource, PluginListPanel/ConfigPanel wiring, NavigationButton construction and toolbar add/remove lifecycle.

proposals.note: Source-correlated exact-v308 recovery of RuneLite ConfigPlugin.
